author: CNN
description:
In the wake of the US losing its measles elimination status, how can we understand why some parents have lost trust in our public health institutions and choose to delay or reject routine vaccinations for their children?

“We’ve asked mothers in particular to read all the labels, to assess every ingredient in every household product. We know that parents in general have fatigue for the number of decisions every day they’re being asked to make.”

Chasing Life with Dr. Sanjay Gupta is available on the CNN app and wherever you get your podcasts.
title: America Is Losing the War Against Measles

author: CNN
description:
Video recorded by a bystander shows federal agents detaining two people on a jet bridge at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday, as a woman screams in the background. 

In a statement to CNN, DHS said that ICE officers carried out a targeted operation to arrest Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, a Mexican national who DHS said had overstayed his visa. He was arrested, along with Sofia Hernandez Mejia, who said in the video she has a work permit, but was determined to have also overstayed her visa, according to ICE.
title: Video shows agents restrain two people on the ground at Seattle airport

Finally, tit for tat attacks continued in the Iran war this week and Israel launched a military operation in the Hamas-controlled areas of Gaza. What is the way out for the war-torn region? Fareed sits down to discuss with Egypt’s Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty.

Meet the Latinos of East Lost Angeles who are fighting to live the American dream while facing prejudice and intolerance. Follow comedian and political gadfly W. Kamau Bell as he explores the far corners of our country and its various groups and subcultures. In his own words: “Despite the rhetoric of the right that demonizes, criminalizes and attempts to demoralize and sometimes outright arch-villianize Latinos, every Latino person I met during this episode was very hopeful about their future, no matter how dire their circumstances in the present seemed to me. And not even just hopeful, but extremely joyful about their lives and futures.”
